## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

A modern UI style with soft, rounded, three-dimensional, "puffy" shapes that
mimic malleable, colorful clay.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, high-contrast, playful
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Montserrat,
  display=Poppins, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600,
  700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#FFFFFF, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#1C398E
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Soft, rounded three-dimensional shapes that mimic malleable clay with playful,
puffy
elements and colorful surfaces.
